The vehicle may start the engine forcibly, or maintain exhaust back pressure of the engine to improve the possibility of passing through the wading area and safety of the vehicle. nPlease enable wading protection before driving into the wading area. If the engine is not started successfully after wading protection is enabled, do not drive into the wading area. If the vehicle is driven into the wading area in EV mode, or the engine stalls during wading process, please contact the authorized service store for overhaul of related parts timely.
After wading protection is enabled, and the engine is started successfully, the following conditions should be met:
● Wading depth < 700 mm 
● Initial SOC > 20% 
● No abnormal condition of the vehicle, and no light alarm in the instrument 
● Avoid driving in turbulent water (flood included) 
● Avoid driving or stopping in the deep water area for a long time 
Compliance with the conditions above will contribute to the safe use of wading protection. However, this function is unable to detect or predict whether the actual water depth increases rapidly, and to predict whether it is safe to continue driving. Please evaluate the driving situation of your vehicle in the wading area by yourself, and enable or disable wading protection in time according to the instructions and the risk alert. 
Considering objective factors such as driving environment, weather, software & hardware, network availability, we cannot guarantee this function works normally at any time. Please actively focus on driving conditions. 
Please prudently allow others to use wading protection for driving safety. Otherwise, BYD will not be liable for damages unless otherwise expressly specified by laws and regulations or BYD is the party in fault.
